compiled_state.description:
## Where this came from

Step-7 sibling sweep of `smudgeless-friendless-longspur` (`1205-63b2-2c01-4e7f`), whose confirmed
root cause is an unbounded external command inside a periodic probe on a `Type=oneshot` unit with
no start timeout. That combination took Gerrit off the air for 41 minutes. The sweep looked for the
same shape elsewhere; these two hits were confirmed semantically (read in context) and are filed
rather than fixed, because they are outside the blast radius that change reviewed.

## Hit 1 — `infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh:787`: unbounded `git clone`

```
if ! git clone -q "$MIRROR_URL" "$MIRROR_DIR" 2>/dev/null; then
```

No bound of any kind, inside the unit driven every 2 minutes by `rebar-autodeploy.timer`. Its
SIBLING one line down is already correct — `autodeploy.sh:798` wraps `git fetch` in
`timeout "$FETCH_TIMEOUT"` — so the omission is inconsistent within the same function, which is
the same signature the 1205 scans had against the `DOCKER_DU_TIMEOUT` calls in their own file.

Partially mitigated by 1205's fix: `rebar-autodeploy.service` now carries `TimeoutStartSec=90`, so a
hung clone can no longer delete the timer's next elapse. The clone itself is still unbounded, so it
can still consume its whole 90 seconds against a stalling remote on every tick.

This path runs only when `$MIRROR_DIR` is absent (a fresh box or a wiped mirror), which is why it is
lower priority than the probe scans were.

## Hit 2 — `infra/scripts/install-certbot-timer.sh:69`: `Type=oneshot`, no `TimeoutStartSec`

Rendered with `OnCalendar=*-*-* 00,12:00:00`. Less dangerous than the observability unit because
`OnCalendar` is absolute wall-clock rather than computed from the last completed activation, so a
hung run does not delete the next elapse the way `OnUnitActiveSec` does. It still leaves a unit
`activating` forever with nothing to kill it, and systemd will not start a second activation while
the first is running, so certificate renewal silently stops.

## Explicitly NOT filed, with the reason

`bootstrap-gerrit-admin.sh`, `compose-up.sh` and `mcp-entrypoint.sh` also make unbounded `curl` /
`git clone` calls. They are one-shot bootstrap and container-entry paths, not periodic units, so a
hang there is visible as a failed boot rather than as a silently missing metric. Different failure
mode, out of this category. Recorded so the sweep's coverage is legible rather than looking like an
omission.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] AC1 - `autodeploy.sh`'s mirror `git clone` carries a finite wall-clock bound, using the same
      idiom as the `git fetch` beside it.
- [ ] AC2 - A hanging clone is shown to terminate: the script is driven with a stubbed `git` that
      blocks, and the run still completes.
- [ ] AC3 - The rendered certbot service declares a finite `TimeoutStartSec`, asserted against the
      rendered unit rather than the script text.
compiled_state.title: Two more systemd oneshots can hang unbounded: autodeploy's mirror `git clone` and the certbot unit's missing TimeoutStartSec
